name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a high-contrast skip link at the top of every page that jumps straight to the main content, allowing keyboard users to bypass navigation. This is the best option because it lets users quickly access the content they need, reducing frustration and improving overall experience. By doing this, we're accepting the trade-off of adding a small amount of visual clutter to the page, but it's worth it for the significant improvement in accessibility. This decision aligns with our goal of making EXCAVA usable by everyone, especially those who rely on keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: A single high-contrast skip link fails users who rely on screen readers when the page re-renders dynamically—it disappears from the tab order. Instead, add a persistent skip link that appears on keyboard focus *and* survives DOM updates. Test with a screen reader: if it can’t reach the skip link after a state change, the alternative fails.
